item.title: A macOS backdoor that reads its C2 off the blockchain
item.description: Someone sent me a terminal command disguised as an installer. This walks through taking it apart one layer at a time, down to a final stage that reads its command-and-control address off the Polygon blockchain instead of hardcoding it.
